custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create 35 active parts for this test whose part numbers start with the same text, so one search lists all 35.
  • Have another active part, part A, whose part number does not start with that text.
  • Use a computer that can open the exported file in a spreadsheet program.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573668-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573668-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Export is in the Inventory list's three-dot actions menu (with Cycle count and Deactivate parts); it downloads a file.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The 35 parts are listed (the list loads 30 rows until you scroll).

Step 2:

  • The list stays at its first rows.

Step 3:

  • The menu opens.

Step 4:

  • A file downloads.

Step 5:

  • The file holds 35 part rows, one for each part the search matches, so it also holds the 5 rows not yet loaded (35 − 30 = 5).
  • Part A is not in the file, because the search does not match it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S1-R9b: “The export includes every part on that tab that matches the current search, filters and Supply filter, including parts not yet scrolled into view. With nothing matching, the message "Empty export" shows and no file is made.”
  • S1-R9: “Export in the actions menu exports the parts on the tab that shows: active parts from the Active tab, inactive parts from the Inactive tab.”
  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row loaded in the list. The list loads 30 parts at a time as the user scrolls, so it ticks only the rows loaded so far. The count in the bar shows exactly how many parts will change.”
